identity.summary: UFC lists the South Korean light heavyweight; an IJF judoka of the same name competed for Korea.

national.note: IJF entrant lists name a Korean judoka Da Woon JUNG (IJF person 4043) at the 2013 World Championships (−78 kg) and the 2010 and 2011 Tokyo Grand Slams, losing his first contest each time. The IJF data hides birth dates, so identity with the UFC fighter is not yet established. Resolve with a source linking the UFC fighter to judo for Korea.
